definitions.full: H3472. Yishpah יִשְׁמָּה proper name, masculine in Benjamin 1Chr 8:16 , Σαφαν , ᵐ5 L Ιεσφα . — יָָֽשְׁפֶה see above II. שׁפה (compare Arabic stone (one of three) supporting kettle, Aramaic tripod , also תַּפְיָא fire-jar ; hence perhaps as denominative Hebrew [ שָׁפַת ] q. v., Frä 53 ; compare II., Aramaic , תְּפִי set on a kettle or pot ; see also GFM Judg 5:16 RS Semitic i. 357, 2nd ed. 377 ).
